productName: French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table
description:
When nothing but the best will do, choose the French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table from Old Time Oak. This magnificent piece offers seven dovetailed drawers of storage plus a dedicated changing station, making it the ultimate nursery investment.
Seven spacious drawers with full-extension glides provide abundant organized space for clothing, bedding, diapers, wipes, and nursery essentials. The attached changing table features safety rails and a comfortable working height, creating a safe, convenient diaper station. The solid wood frame with French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, brings timeless elegance to your nursery.
Built from solid wood with non-toxic, baby-safe finishes, this dresser is designed to last through every stage of childhood. After the diaper years, simply remove the changing table to reveal a stunning seven-drawer dresser that transitions beautifully into a child's or teen's bedroom. Coordinates with the complete French Country collection.
